<a name="connectedCallback"></a>

## connectedCallback()
Loads the full list of SOR codes for the current profile from Apex on
component init; subsequent filtering is handled client-side.

**Kind**: global function  
<a name="filterResults"></a>

## filterResults()
Filters the full SOR list client-side using multi-word AND logic across
 sorCode, heading, and fullDescription, then resets pagination.

**Kind**: global function
